shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head, torso and detailed headgear/cap
frontal/profile human-like body with decorated garment or chest ornament
circular disc motif (roundel on A's chest, round object held in B)
justification: Both show human-like figures rendered in carved relief, and both include a circular disc element (a roundel on the chest in A, a round object held between the two figures in B), but this is generic. A is a single massive, frontal, schematic block-like figure with abstract chest ornaments and no interaction, whereas B is a naturalistic profile scene of two bearded figures in patterned robes facing one another with an exchanged object and weapons, so the composition, posture conventions and level of naturalism differ fundamentally.
